directions.name: 认知主权
directions.question: 我的注意力、价值观和判断标准，有多少真正属于我自己？

en.name: Cognitive Sovereignty
en.question: How much of my attention, my values and my standards of judgment truly belongs to me?

directions.name: 自我与精神自由
directions.question: 如果不必满足任何人的期待，我会怎样度过这一生？

en.name: Self and Inner Freedom
en.question: If I didn't have to live up to anyone's expectations, how would I spend this life?

directions.name: 社会与人性洞察
directions.question: 我以为理所当然的世界，有多少是被社会建构出来的？

en.name: Society and Human Nature
en.question: How much of the world I take for granted was built by society?

directions.name: 哲学与生命意义
directions.question: 如果效率、成就、财富都不能定义人生，什么能？

en.name: Philosophy and Meaning
en.question: If efficiency, achievement and wealth can't define a life, what can?

directions.name: 文学与情感深度
directions.sub: 在别人的生命里理解自己
directions.question: 我是真的理解人，还是只会用几个概念解释人？

en.name: Literature and Emotional Depth
en.question: Do I really understand people, or can I only explain them with a few concepts?

directions.name: 艺术与审美
directions.question: 我还能真正地看见、听见、感受世界，而不只是识别和消费它吗？

en.name: Art and Aesthetics
en.question: Can I still truly see, hear and feel the world, rather than just recognize and consume it?

directions.name: 历史与文明视野
directions.question: 如果生在另一个时代、国家或阶层，我还会相信现在所信的吗？

en.name: History and Civilization
en.question: Born in another age, country or class, would I still believe what I believe now?

directions.name: 科学与世界观
directions.question: 我追求的是真相，还是让我感觉正确的解释？

en.name: Science and Worldview
en.question: Am I after the truth, or the explanation that makes me feel right?

directions.name: 心理与内在世界
directions.question: 我的情绪、恐惧和重复犯的错，从哪里来？

en.name: Psychology and the Inner World
en.sub: Understand the machine that is you
en.question: Where do my emotions, my fears and the mistakes I keep repeating come from?

directions.name: 财富与金钱观
directions.sub: 不被钱支配，也不假装清高
directions.question: 多少才算够？我想用钱换什么？

en.name: Wealth and Money
en.sub: Not ruled by money, not pretending to be above it
en.question: How much is enough? What do I want money to buy me?

directions.name: 创造与创业
directions.question: 我想让世界上多出一个什么东西？我愿意为它承担什么风险？

en.name: Creation and Entrepreneurship
en.question: What do I want to add to the world? What risk am I willing to take for it?

en.name: Season 1
en.theme: Breaking the ice: reclaim your attention

seasons.name: 第二季
seasons.theme: 看见自己：我是被什么塑造的

seasons.name: 第三季
seasons.theme: 看见世界：结构、历史与人

en.name: Season 3
en.theme: Seeing the world: structures, history and people

en.name: Season 4
en.theme: The deep dive: conversing with the greatest

books.title: 《昨日的世界》
books.author: 茨威格（舒昌善 译）
books.note: 从已经爱上的作者开始。写《陌生女人》的那个人，看着自己的文明世界崩塌。

en.title: The World of Yesterday
en.author: Stefan Zweig
en.note: Start with an author you already love. The man who wrote Letter from an Unknown Woman watches his civilized world collapse.

books.title: 《娱乐至死》
books.author: 尼尔·波兹曼
books.note: 1985 年写电视，句句在说短视频：媒介的形态决定了我们能思考什么级别的真理。

en.title: Amusing Ourselves to Death
en.author: Neil Postman
en.note: Written about television in 1985; every sentence is about short video. The form of a medium decides what grade of truth we can think about.

books.title: 《观看之道》
books.author: 约翰·伯格
books.note: 很薄，图多。读完再刷信息流，看到的不再是刺激，而是背后的操盘逻辑。

en.title: Ways of Seeing
en.author: John Berger
en.note: Thin, with lots of pictures. Afterwards, scrolling your feed you stop seeing stimuli and start seeing the logic pulling the strings.

books.title: 《如何阅读一本书》
books.author: 艾德勒 / 范多伦
books.note: 磨刀。"分析阅读""主题阅读"是之后所有书的方法。

en.title: How to Read a Book
en.author: Mortimer J. Adler / Charles Van Doren
en.note: Sharpen the blade first. Analytical reading and syntopical reading are the method for every book after it.

books.title: 《倦怠社会》
books.author: 韩炳哲
books.note: 一百页。为什么越自由越累，为什么我们丧失了"深度无聊"的能力。

en.title: The Burnout Society
en.author: Byung-Chul Han
en.note: A hundred pages. Why the freer we are the more tired we get, and why we have lost the capacity for deep boredom.

books.title: 《我与地坛》
books.author: 史铁生
books.note: 现代汉语散文的高点。如何与命运和生命的局限共处。

en.title: The Temple of Earth and I
en.author: Shi Tiesheng
en.note: A high point of modern Chinese prose. How to live alongside fate and the limits of a life.

books.title: 《我的天才女友》
books.author: 埃莱娜·费兰特（陈英 译）
books.note: 《纽约时报》"21 世纪百佳"第一名。两个女孩、阶层、教育、友谊里的嫉妒与爱。

en.title: My Brilliant Friend
en.author: Elena Ferrante
en.note: No. 1 on The New York Times list of the best books of the 21st century. Two girls, class, education, and the envy and love inside a friendship.

books.title: 《活出生命的意义》
books.author: 维克多·弗兰克尔
books.note: 一切都被剥夺之后，人最后的自由是什么。

en.title: Man's Search for Meaning
en.author: Viktor E. Frankl
en.note: When everything else has been taken away, what is a person's last freedom?

books.title: 《悉达多》
books.author: 黑塞（姜乙 译）
books.note: 智慧无法被传授，哪怕老师是佛陀。对"拒绝把人生答案外包"最美的隐喻。

en.title: Siddhartha
en.author: Hermann Hesse
en.note: Wisdom can't be taught, even when the teacher is the Buddha. The most beautiful metaphor for refusing to outsource the answers to your life.

books.title: 《乡土中国》
books.author: 费孝通
books.note: 中国人的戈夫曼。"差序格局"四个字解释了一半的人情世故。

en.title: From the Soil
en.author: Fei Xiaotong
en.note: China's own Goffman. The phrase "differential mode of association" explains half of how social ties work in China.

books.title: 《悠悠岁月》
books.author: 安妮·埃尔诺（吴岳添 译）
books.note: 把个人记忆写成社会学。塔拉与戈夫曼在此交汇。

en.title: The Years
en.author: Annie Ernaux
en.note: Personal memory written as sociology. Educated and Goffman meet here.

books.title: 《美的历程》
books.author: 李泽厚
books.note: 从青铜饕餮到明清小说，一口气贯通中国审美史。

en.title: The Path of Beauty
en.author: Li Zehou
en.note: From bronze-age taotie masks to Ming and Qing novels: the whole history of Chinese aesthetics in one breath.

books.title: 《不能承受的生命之轻》
books.author: 米兰·昆德拉（许钧 译）
books.note: 对"媚俗"的解剖。读完对廉价感动和精致表演有本能的免疫力。

en.title: The Unbearable Lightness of Being
en.author: Milan Kundera
en.note: An anatomy of kitsch. Afterwards you are instinctively immune to cheap sentiment and polished performance.

books.title: 《社会学的想象力》
books.author: C. 赖特·米尔斯
books.note: 把"个人困扰"翻译成"公共议题"的能力。国际社会学协会世纪经典第二名。

en.title: The Sociological Imagination
en.author: C. Wright Mills
en.note: The ability to translate personal troubles into public issues. No. 2 on the International Sociological Association's books of the century.

books.title: 《国家的视角》
books.author: 詹姆斯·C. 斯科特（王晓毅 译）
books.note: 追求清晰指标的宏大规划如何系统性地摧毁"默会知识"。AI 时代读，脊背发凉。

en.title: Seeing Like a State
en.author: James C. Scott
en.note: How grand plans chasing legible metrics systematically destroy tacit knowledge. Read in the age of AI, it sends a chill down your spine.

books.title: 《安娜·卡列尼娜》
books.author: 托尔斯泰（草婴 译）
books.note: 小说的天花板。没有一个人物是工具，每个人都有自己的道理。

en.title: Anna Karenina
en.author: Leo Tolstoy
en.note: The ceiling of the novel. Not one character is a device; everyone has their own reasons.

books.title: 《万历十五年》
books.author: 黄仁宇
books.note: 从一个平淡的年份看一个文明的困局。

en.title: 1587, A Year of No Significance
en.author: Ray Huang
en.note: An uneventful year reveals the deadlock of a whole civilization.

books.title: 《艺术的故事》
books.author: 贡布里希
books.note: "没有艺术这回事，只有艺术家。"配合去美术馆读。

en.title: The Story of Art
en.author: E. H. Gombrich
en.note: "There really is no such thing as Art. There are only artists." Read it alongside trips to museums.

books.title: 《西西弗神话》
books.author: 加缪
books.note: "真正严肃的哲学问题只有一个。"读完接着读《局外人》。

en.title: The Myth of Sisyphus
en.author: Albert Camus
en.note: "There is but one truly serious philosophical problem." Follow it with The Stranger.

books.title: 《人的境况》
books.author: 汉娜·阿伦特
books.note: 劳动、工作、行动。当劳动可以被自动化，人还剩下什么——她 1958 年就在想。

en.title: The Human Condition
en.author: Hannah Arendt
en.note: Labor, work, action. When labor can be automated, what is left for us? She was asking in 1958.

books.title: 《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》
books.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基（荣如德 译）
books.note: 茨威格最膜拜的灵魂解剖师。"宗教大法官"一章读三遍。

en.title: The Brothers Karamazov
en.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
en.note: The anatomist of the soul Zweig revered most. Read "The Grand Inquisitor" three times.

books.title: 《庄子》
books.author: 庄子（陈鼓应《庄子今注今译》）
books.note: 汉语里最自由的头脑。先读内七篇。

en.title: Zhuangzi
en.author: Zhuangzi
en.note: The freest mind ever to write in Chinese. Start with the seven Inner Chapters.

books.title: 《九诗心》
books.author: 黄晓丹
books.note: 豆瓣 2025 年度图书第一名。九位诗人如何在乱世安顿自己。

en.title: Nine Poets' Hearts
en.author: Huang Xiaodan
en.note: Douban's No. 1 book of 2025. How nine poets found peace in troubled times.

books.title: 《红楼梦》
books.author: 曹雪芹（人民文学出版社校注本）
books.note: 全年慢读到此收官。中文审美的总和。

en.title: Dream of the Red Chamber
en.author: Cao Xueqin
en.note: The year of slow reading ends here. The sum of Chinese aesthetics.

books.title: 《升维阅读》（Reader, Come Home）
books.author: 玛丽安娜·沃尔夫
books.note: 与这个项目的初衷最直接相关：神经科学家讲"深度阅读回路"用进废退。

en.title: Reader, Come Home
en.author: Maryanne Wolf
en.note: The book closest to why this project exists: a neuroscientist on the deep-reading circuit, which you either use or lose.

books.title: 《浅薄》
books.author: 尼古拉斯·卡尔
books.note: 2010 年写互联网，放到 AI 时代更准：外包的不只是记忆，是综合与判断。

en.title: The Shallows
en.author: Nicholas Carr
en.note: Written about the internet in 2010 and truer in the age of AI: what we outsource is not just memory but synthesis and judgment.

books.title: 《如何无所事事》
books.author: 珍妮·奥德尔
books.note: 对抗注意力经济。为什么每一分钟都必须有产出？

en.title: How to Do Nothing
en.author: Jenny Odell
en.note: Resisting the attention economy. Why must every minute produce something?

books.title: 《论自由》
books.author: 约翰·密尔
books.note: 为什么必须亲自思考、亲自听反对意见。第二章是最好的论证。

en.title: On Liberty
en.author: John Stuart Mill
en.note: Why you must think for yourself and hear the other side yourself. Chapter 2 is the best argument.

books.title: 《反脆弱》
books.author: 纳西姆·塔勒布
books.note: 鄙视把判断外包给模型和专家。傲慢、啰嗦、不可替代。

en.title: Antifragile
en.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
en.note: Contempt for outsourcing judgment to models and experts. Arrogant, long-winded, irreplaceable.

books.title: 《深度工作》
books.author: 卡尔·纽波特
books.note: 可操作。把专注当作需要训练的稀缺技能。

en.title: Deep Work
en.author: Cal Newport
en.note: Practical. Treats focus as a scarce skill that needs training.

books.title: 《技术垄断》
books.author: 尼尔·波兹曼
books.note: 《娱乐至死》的续篇：当文化向技术投降。

en.title: Technopoly
en.author: Neil Postman
en.note: The sequel to Amusing Ourselves to Death: when culture surrenders to technology.

books.title: 《人有人的用处》
books.author: 诺伯特·维纳
books.note: 控制论之父 1950 年就在问：机器接管之后，人该做什么。

en.title: The Human Use of Human Beings
en.author: Norbert Wiener
en.note: The father of cybernetics was already asking in 1950: once machines take over, what should people do?

books.title: 《心流》
books.author: 米哈里·契克森米哈赖
books.note: 深度专注的心理学基础。

en.title: Flow
en.author: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi
en.note: The psychology underneath deep focus.

books.title: 《哥本哈根三部曲》
books.author: 托芙·迪特莱弗森
books.note: 女性靠文学突破出身，但没有被包装成励志故事：才华、欲望、成瘾同时存在。

en.title: The Copenhagen Trilogy
en.author: Tove Ditlevsen
en.note: A woman writes her way out of her origins, without it being packaged as an inspirational story: talent, desire and addiction all at once.

books.title: 《一间自己的房间》
books.author: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫
books.note: 经济独立与精神创造。一篇讲稿改变了一个世纪。

en.title: A Room of One's Own
en.author: Virginia Woolf
en.note: Money of your own and creative life. One lecture changed a century.

books.title: 《给青年诗人的信》
books.author: 里尔克（冯至 译）
books.note: 十封信。关于孤独、耐心与如何对待心里的问题。

en.title: Letters to a Young Poet
en.author: Rainer Maria Rilke
en.note: Ten letters on solitude, patience and how to live with the questions in your heart.

books.title: 《当呼吸化为空气》
books.author: 保罗·卡拉尼什
books.note: 神经外科医生在 36 岁面对死亡时写下的。

en.title: When Breath Becomes Air
en.author: Paul Kalanithi
en.note: Written by a neurosurgeon facing death at 36.

books.title: 《玻璃城堡》
books.author: 珍妮特·沃尔斯
books.note: 与 Educated 最常并提：如何爱一对毁了你童年的父母。

en.title: The Glass Castle
en.author: Jeannette Walls
en.note: The book most often mentioned with Educated: how to love parents who wrecked your childhood.

books.title: 《我是寨子里长大的女孩》
books.author: 扎十一惹
books.note: 豆瓣 2025 年度图书前十。从云南山寨走出来的中国版 Educated。
books.key: 我是寨子里长大的女孩

en.title: A Girl Who Grew Up in the Mountain Village
en.author: Zha Shiyire
en.note: One of Douban's top ten books of 2025. China's own Educated, by a woman who left a mountain village in Yunnan.

books.title: 《秋园》
books.author: 杨本芬
books.note: 八十岁的女儿在厨房里写母亲的一生。

en.title: Autumn Garden
en.author: Yang Benfen
en.note: An eighty-year-old daughter writes her mother's life at the kitchen table.

books.title: 《巨流河》
books.author: 齐邦媛
books.note: 一个人的一生，一个国家的二十世纪。

en.title: The Great Flowing River
en.author: Chi Pang-yuan
en.note: One woman's life, one country's twentieth century.

books.title: 《爱的艺术》
books.author: 埃里希·弗洛姆
books.note: 爱是需要学习的能力，不是运气。

en.title: The Art of Loving
en.author: Erich Fromm
en.note: Love is a capacity you learn, not a matter of luck.

books.title: 《牧羊少年奇幻之旅》
books.author: 保罗·柯艾略（丁文林 译）
books.note: 一则寓言：追随自己的天命，路上的每一站都是答案的一部分。迷路时读。

en.title: The Alchemist
en.author: Paulo Coelho
en.note: A fable: follow your own calling, and every stop on the road is part of the answer. For when you feel lost.

books.title: 《哲学家的最后一课》
books.author: 朱锐
books.note: 豆瓣 2025 年度图书前十。哲学教授在生命最后十天谈死亡。

en.title: The Philosopher's Last Lesson
en.author: Zhu Rui
en.note: One of Douban's top ten books of 2025. A philosophy professor talks about death in the last ten days of his life.

books.title: Things in Nature Merely Grow
books.author: 李翊云
books.note: 2026 年普利策回忆录奖。失去两个儿子之后如何继续活。极克制，极重。

en.title: Things in Nature Merely Grow
en.author: Yiyun Li
en.note: 2026 Pulitzer Prize for Memoir. How to go on living after losing two sons. Deeply restrained, deeply heavy.

books.title: 《污名》
books.author: 欧文·戈夫曼
books.note: 《自我呈现》的下一本：被贴了标签的人如何管理身份。

en.title: Stigma
en.author: Erving Goffman
en.note: The next step after The Presentation of Self: how labeled people manage their identity.

books.title: 《区分：判断力的社会批判》
books.author: 布迪厄
books.note: 你的品味是你的吗？难读，但会永久改变你看"审美"的方式。
books.key: 区分：判断力的社会批判

en.title: Distinction: A Social Critique of the Judgement of Taste
en.author: Pierre Bourdieu
en.note: Is your taste really yours? Hard going, but it permanently changes how you see "taste".

books.title: 《现实的社会建构》
books.author: 伯格 / 卢克曼
books.note: 共识如何变成"现实"。戈夫曼的理论地基。

en.title: The Social Construction of Reality
en.author: Peter L. Berger / Thomas Luckmann
en.note: How consensus becomes "reality". The theoretical foundation under Goffman.

books.title: 《规训与惩罚》
books.author: 福柯
books.note: 权力不是压在你身上，而是长在你身体里。

en.title: Discipline and Punish
en.author: Michel Foucault
en.note: Power doesn't press down on you; it grows inside your body.

books.title: 《逃避自由》
books.author: 埃里希·弗洛姆
books.note: 人为什么主动交出自由——正是这个项目要对抗的事。

en.title: Escape from Freedom
en.author: Erich Fromm
en.note: Why people hand over their freedom willingly, which is exactly what this project is fighting.

books.title: 《第二性》
books.author: 波伏瓦（郑克鲁 译）
books.note: "女人不是天生的，而是后天形成的。"

en.title: The Second Sex
en.author: Simone de Beauvoir
en.note: "One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman."

books.title: 《不平等的童年》
books.author: 安妮特·拉鲁
books.note: 阶层如何通过养育代际传递。Educated 的学术背面。

en.title: Unequal Childhoods
en.author: Annette Lareau
en.note: How class passes down through parenting. The academic flip side of Educated.

books.title: 《景观社会》
books.author: 居伊·德波
books.note: 1967 年预言了朋友圈：生活退化为被观看的表象。

en.title: The Society of the Spectacle
en.author: Guy Debord
en.note: Predicted social media feeds in 1967: life degraded into an appearance to be watched.

books.title: 《想象的共同体》
books.author: 本尼迪克特·安德森
books.note: "民族"是怎样被印刷品想象出来的。

en.title: Imagined Communities
en.author: Benedict Anderson
en.note: How print imagined the nation into being.

books.title: 《把自己作为方法》
books.author: 项飙 / 吴琦
books.note: 对话体，好读。"附近的消失"。

en.title: Self as Method
en.author: Xiang Biao / Wu Qi
en.note: A conversation, easy to read. On "the disappearance of the nearby".

books.title: 《沉思录》

en.title: A Brief History of Intelligence
en.author: Max Bennett
en.note: From worms to GPT, the brain made five breakthroughs. Evolution, neuroscience and AI on one timeline.

books.title: 《千脑智能》
books.author: 杰夫·霍金斯
books.note: 新皮层里有成千上万个世界模型在投票。一个工程师对"理解"的大胆解释，可争论。

en.title: A Thousand Brains
en.author: Jeff Hawkins
en.note: Thousands of world models in the neocortex, voting. An engineer's bold account of what understanding is; open to argument.

books.title: Other Minds
books.author: 彼得·戈弗雷-史密斯
books.note: 章鱼是演化在另一条路上造出的心智。一个哲学家潜进海里，追问意识从哪里来。

en.title: Other Minds
en.author: Peter Godfrey-Smith
en.note: The octopus is a mind evolution built down a different road. A philosopher dives in to ask where consciousness comes from.

books.title: The Secret of Our Success
books.author: 约瑟夫·亨里奇
books.note: 人类聪明靠的不是单个大脑，而是代代积累的文化。讲智人为何胜出，这本证据扎实得多。

en.title: The Secret of Our Success
en.author: Joseph Henrich
en.note: Humans are clever not because of single brains but because of culture piled up over generations. A far better-evidenced account of why our species won.

books.title: 《脑与意识》
books.author: 斯坦尼斯拉斯·迪昂
books.note: 意识第一次成了能在实验室里测量的东西。

en.title: Consciousness and the Brain
en.author: Stanislas Dehaene
en.note: Consciousness becomes, for the first time, something you can measure in a lab.

books.title: Being You
books.author: 阿尼尔·塞斯
books.note: 大脑是一台预测机器，你看到的世界是"受控的幻觉"，连"我"也是。

en.title: Being You
en.author: Anil Seth
en.note: The brain is a prediction machine; the world you see is a controlled hallucination, and so is the self.

books.title: 《为什么》
books.author: 朱迪亚·珀尔
books.note: 因果的三级阶梯。看清今天的 AI 还缺什么。

en.title: The Book of Why
en.author: Judea Pearl
en.note: The three rungs of the ladder of causation. See what today's AI is still missing.

books.title: 《人机对齐》
books.author: 布莱恩·克里斯汀
books.note: 机器学到的是我们说的，还是我们做的？AI 安全问题的来龙去脉。

en.title: The Alignment Problem
en.author: Brian Christian
en.note: Do machines learn what we say, or what we do? Where the problem of AI safety came from.

books.title: 《我看见的世界》
books.author: 李飞飞
books.note: 移民女孩、洗衣店、ImageNet。一部深度学习史，也是一个人的一生。

en.title: The Worlds I See
en.author: Fei-Fei Li
en.note: An immigrant girl, a dry-cleaning shop, ImageNet. A history of deep learning, and one person's life.

books.title: An Immense World
books.author: 埃德·扬
books.note: 每种动物都活在自己的感官世界里。读完才知道人类的"现实"有多窄。

en.title: An Immense World
en.author: Ed Yong
en.note: Every animal lives inside its own world of senses. You come away seeing how narrow human reality is.

books.title: 《象与骑象人》（The Happiness Hypothesis）
books.author: 乔纳森·海特
books.note: 十个古老的观念，逐一用现代研究检验。

en.title: The Happiness Hypothesis
en.author: Jonathan Haidt
en.note: Ten ancient ideas, each tested against modern research.

books.title: 《回忆·梦·思考》
books.author: 荣格
books.note: 荣格的自传。一个人如何把一生过成对无意识的探索。

en.title: Memories, Dreams, Reflections
en.author: C. G. Jung
en.note: Jung's autobiography. How one man made his life an exploration of the unconscious.

books.title: 《精神分析引论》
books.author: 弗洛伊德
books.note: 很多结论已被推翻，但他改变了人类谈论自己的方式。读原典，而不是读转述。

en.title: Introductory Lectures on Psychoanalysis
en.author: Sigmund Freud
en.note: Many conclusions have been overturned, but he changed how people talk about themselves. Read the original, not a summary.

books.title: 《我们时代的神经症人格》
books.author: 卡伦·霍妮
books.note: 对爱的病态渴求、对成功的病态追逐——写于 1937 年，像在写今天。
books.key: 我们时代的神经症人格

en.title: The Neurotic Personality of Our Time
en.author: Karen Horney
en.note: A morbid craving for love, a morbid chase after success. Written in 1937, it reads like today.

books.title: 《个人形成论》
books.author: 卡尔·罗杰斯
books.note: "成为一个人"意味着什么。人本主义心理学的源头。

en.title: On Becoming a Person
en.author: Carl Rogers
en.note: What it means to become a person. The source of humanistic psychology.

books.title: 《直视骄阳》《当尼采哭泣》
books.author: 欧文·亚隆
books.note: 存在主义心理治疗师。前者谈死亡焦虑，后者是哲学与心理学交织的小说。

en.title: Staring at the Sun / When Nietzsche Wept
en.author: Irvin D. Yalom
en.note: An existential psychotherapist. The first is about the fear of death; the second is a novel where philosophy and psychology meet.

books.title: 《也许你该找个人聊聊》
books.author: 洛莉·戈特利布
books.note: 心理治疗师自己去看心理治疗师。好读，且诚实。

en.title: Maybe You Should Talk to Someone
en.author: Lori Gottlieb
en.note: A therapist goes to see a therapist. Easy to read, and honest.

books.title: 《被讨厌的勇气》
books.author: 岸见一郎 / 古贺史健
books.note: 阿德勒的"课题分离"。对话体，很轻，但对在意他人眼光的人是一剂猛药。

en.title: The Courage to Be Disliked
en.author: Ichiro Kishimi / Fumitake Koga
en.note: Adler's "separation of tasks". A light dialogue, but strong medicine for anyone who cares too much what others think.

books.title: 《身体从未忘记》
books.author: 巴塞尔·范德考克
books.note: 创伤如何留在身体里。影响极大，部分疗法的证据有争议，带着这点读。

en.title: The Body Keeps the Score
en.author: Bessel van der Kolk
en.note: How trauma stays in the body. Hugely influential; the evidence for some therapies is disputed, so read with that in mind.

books.title: 《社会性动物》
books.author: 埃利奥特·阿伦森
books.note: 社会心理学的经典教科书，却写得像散文。从戈夫曼通向实验室。

en.title: The Social Animal
en.author: Elliot Aronson
en.note: A classic textbook of social psychology that reads like an essay. The road from Goffman to the lab.

books.title: 《亲密关系》
books.author: 罗兰·米勒
books.note: 关于爱情与关系，研究到底发现了什么。

en.title: Intimate Relationships
en.author: Rowland S. Miller
en.note: What research has actually found about love and relationships.

books.title: 《金钱心理学》
books.author: 摩根·豪泽尔
books.note: "财富是你没花掉的钱。"关于够、运气、复利与耐心。

en.title: The Psychology of Money
en.author: Morgan Housel
en.note: "Wealth is the money you don't spend." On enough, luck, compounding and patience.

books.title: 《穷查理宝典》
books.author: 查理·芒格
books.note: 多元思维模型，以及"人类误判心理学"那篇演讲。

en.title: Poor Charlie's Almanack
en.author: Charlie Munger
en.note: Mental models from many disciplines, and the talk on the psychology of human misjudgment.

books.title: 《巴菲特致股东的信》
books.author: 沃伦·巴菲特
books.note: 五十年的一手思考，比任何解读巴菲特的书都好。

en.title: Berkshire Hathaway Letters to Shareholders
en.author: Warren Buffett
en.note: Fifty years of first-hand thinking, better than any book about Buffett.

books.title: 《聪明的投资者》
books.author: 本杰明·格雷厄姆
books.note: "市场先生"与"安全边际"。重点读第 8、20 章。

en.title: The Intelligent Investor
en.author: Benjamin Graham
en.note: Mr. Market and the margin of safety. Focus on chapters 8 and 20.

books.title: 《漫步华尔街》
books.author: 伯顿·马尔基尔
books.note: 为什么大多数人应该买指数基金然后去读书。

en.title: A Random Walk Down Wall Street
en.author: Burton G. Malkiel
en.note: Why most people should buy index funds and go read books.

books.title: 《随机漫步的傻瓜》
books.author: 纳西姆·塔勒布
books.note: 我们如何把运气错认成能力。《反脆弱》的前传。

en.title: Fooled by Randomness
en.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
en.note: How we mistake luck for skill. The prequel to Antifragile.

books.title: 《纳瓦尔宝典》
books.author: 埃里克·乔根森 编
books.note: 财富与幸福的格言集。追求财富而不是金钱或地位；杠杆与专长。

en.title: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant
en.author: Eric Jorgenson (ed.)
en.note: Aphorisms on wealth and happiness. Seek wealth, not money or status; leverage and specific knowledge.

books.title: 《最优解人生》（Die with Zero）
books.author: 比尔·柏金斯
books.note: 反方：钱是用来换体验的，存得太多也是一种浪费。和《金钱心理学》对着读。

en.title: Die with Zero
en.author: Bill Perkins
en.note: The opposing view: money is for buying experiences, and saving too much is its own waste. Read it against The Psychology of Money.

books.title: 《贫穷的本质》
books.author: 班纳吉 / 迪弗洛
books.note: 诺奖经济学家的田野实验：穷人的选择为什么是理性的。

en.title: Poor Economics
en.author: Abhijit V. Banerjee / Esther Duflo
en.note: Field experiments by Nobel-winning economists: why the choices of the poor are rational.

books.title: 《稀缺》
books.author: 穆来纳森 / 沙菲尔
books.note: 缺钱和缺时间如何占用同一种认知带宽。

en.title: Scarcity
en.author: Sendhil Mullainathan / Eldar Shafir
en.note: How a lack of money and a lack of time eat the same cognitive bandwidth.

books.title: 《有闲阶级论》
books.author: 凡勃伦
books.note: "炫耀性消费"的出处。读完很难再为面子花钱。

en.title: The Theory of the Leisure Class
en.author: Thorstein Veblen
en.note: Where "conspicuous consumption" comes from. Afterwards it is hard to spend money to save face.

books.title: 《债：5000 年债务史》
books.author: 大卫·格雷伯
books.note: 人类学家重写货币的起源。钱首先是一种道德关系。

en.title: Debt: The First 5,000 Years
en.author: David Graeber
en.note: An anthropologist rewrites the origins of money. Money is first of all a moral relationship.

books.title: 《新教伦理与资本主义精神》
books.author: 马克斯·韦伯
books.note: 为什么现代人把赚钱当成天职。
books.key: 新教伦理与资本主义精神

en.title: The Protestant Ethic and the Spirit of Capitalism
en.author: Max Weber
en.note: Why modern people treat making money as a calling.

books.title: 《金钱不能买什么》
books.author: 迈克尔·桑德尔
books.note: 当一切都能标价，什么东西会被败坏。

en.title: What Money Can't Buy
en.author: Michael J. Sandel
en.note: When everything has a price, what gets corrupted?

books.title: 《鞋狗》
books.author: 菲尔·奈特
books.note: 耐克的前十八年几乎每年都濒临破产。诚实，且写得好。

en.title: Shoe Dog
en.author: Phil Knight
en.note: Nike's first eighteen years were nearly bankrupt almost every year. Honest, and well written.

books.title: 《从 0 到 1》
books.author: 彼得·蒂尔
books.note: "有什么重要的真相，是很少有人同意你的？"关于逆向思考与垄断。

en.title: Zero to One
en.author: Peter Thiel
en.note: "What important truth do very few people agree with you on?" On contrarian thinking and monopoly.

books.title: 《黑客与画家》
books.author: 保罗·格雷厄姆
books.note: 创造者的随笔集。读完去读他网站上的其余文章。

en.title: Hackers & Painters
en.author: Paul Graham
en.note: Essays by a maker. Then read the rest of the essays on his website.

books.title: 《创新者的窘境》
books.author: 克莱顿·克里斯坦森
books.note: 好公司为什么恰恰因为做对了一切而失败。少数真正有理论的商业书。

en.title: The Innovator's Dilemma
en.author: Clayton M. Christensen
en.note: Why good companies fail precisely because they do everything right. One of the few business books with a real theory.

books.title: 《创业维艰》
books.author: 本·霍洛维茨
books.note: 不讲怎么成功，讲没有好选项时怎么办。

en.title: The Hard Thing About Hard Things
en.author: Ben Horowitz
en.note: Not about how to succeed, but about what to do when there are no good options.

books.title: 《卓有成效的管理者》
books.author: 彼得·德鲁克
books.note: 知识工作者如何管理自己。两百页，没有废话。

en.title: The Effective Executive
en.author: Peter F. Drucker
en.note: How knowledge workers manage themselves. Two hundred pages, no filler.

books.title: 《史蒂夫·乔布斯传》
books.author: 沃尔特·艾萨克森
books.note: 科技与人文的交叉口；以及一个伟大创造者的代价。

en.title: Steve Jobs
en.author: Walter Isaacson
en.note: Where technology meets the humanities; and what it costs to be a great creator.

books.title: 《富兰克林自传》
books.author: 本杰明·富兰克林
books.note: 印刷工、科学家、建国者。自我塑造这一文类的源头。

en.title: The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin
en.author: Benjamin Franklin
en.note: Printer, scientist, founder. The source of the self-made-man genre.

books.title: 《禅与摩托车维修艺术》
books.author: 罗伯特·波西格
books.note: 关于"良质"：把一件事做好，究竟意味着什么。

en.title: Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance
en.author: Robert M. Pirsig
en.note: On Quality: what it really means to do a thing well.

books.title: 《人月神话》
books.author: 弗雷德里克·布鲁克斯
books.note: 写软件工程，其实写的是一群人如何一起造出复杂的东西。

en.title: The Mythical Man-Month
en.author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
en.note: Ostensibly about software engineering; really about how a group of people builds something complex together.
